---
title: Cache
description: Array, file, and Redis cache stores in Kona.
---

import { Tabs, TabItem } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

Kona’s cache layer gives you a small, Laravel-shaped API for storing values by key with optional TTLs.

## Quick start

<Tabs syncKey="lang">
<TabItem label="Kotlin">

```kotlin
val cache = CacheManager(config, basePath, redisManager).store()
cache.put("answer", 42, 60)
val value = cache.get("answer")
val computed = cache.remember("profile", 120) { loadProfile() }
```

</TabItem>
<TabItem label="Java">

```java
Repository cache = new CacheManager(config, basePath, redisManager).store();
cache.put("answer", 42, 60);
Object value = cache.get("answer");
```

</TabItem>
</Tabs>

## Stores

Configure `cache.default` and `cache.stores.{name}.driver`:

| Driver | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `array` / `memory` | Process-local map (great for tests) |
| `file` | JSON files under `storage/framework/cache/data` (or `cache.stores.file.path`) |
| `redis` | Uses `RedisManager` with `cache.prefix` |

## Repository methods

- `get` / `put` / `forever` / `forget` / `flush`
- `has` / `missing` / `add`
- `remember` / `rememberForever` / `pull`
